info.name: AllcosmosSystem - Weighbridge API (Normal Cases)
info.description:
The four APIs the weighbridge calls, one normal request each. Run them in order.

The ref_no, ticket_no and do_no in the bodies are examples: replace them with the test data you created yourself (see "AllcosmosSystem - Weighbridge Integration Guide.md", section 5).

Authentication: HTTP Basic with the username and password given to you (fill the collection variables username and password).

Every request is POST with a JSON body (Content-Type: application/json). The answer is HTTP 200 with { "isSuccess": true|false, "message": "..." }; when isSuccess is false, message says why.

- POST /api/ticketin
- POST /api/ticketout
- POST /api/dotimein
- POST /api/dotimeout

request.description:
A lorry comes in for a Raw Material Planning line or an Import Schedule & Costing container.

Fields (all required):
- ref_no: the Ref No of the line / container (generated by our system, taken from our data).
- ticket_no: the weighbridge ticket no (max 50 characters).
- lorry_no: the lorry plate no (max 20 characters).
- date_in: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

Sending it again overwrites the line / container until it is ticketed out.

Expected: { "isSuccess": true, "message": "Ticket In of Ticket No RT-TEST-01 is saved to Raw Material Planning line RM-TEST-01-RM-TEST-ITEM-1." }

The lorry goes out (after its Ticket In).

Fields:
- ticket_no: the same ticket no as the Ticket In.
- date_out: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, not earlier than the date_in.
- received_qty: received (theoretical) quantity, already converted to the PO unit, > 0, at most 3 decimals.
- weighbridge_qty: quantity calculated from the weighbridge weight, in the PO unit, > 0, at most 3 decimals.
- supplier_delivery_qty: the supplier's delivery quantity, in the PO unit, > 0, at most 3 decimals.
- bin_location (optional, max 15), lot_no (optional, max 20).

Sending it again overwrites the values until the GRN is posted to CSL.

Expected: { "isSuccess": true, "message": "Ticket Out of Ticket No RT-TEST-01 is saved to Raw Material Planning line RM-TEST-01-RM-TEST-ITEM-1. ..." } (the rest says whether the GRN was posted to CSL)

A delivery lorry comes in.

Fields (all required):
- do_no: the DO No of the Daily Delivery Planning lines; every line with this DO No is updated.
- date_in: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, not later than an existing Time Out.

Sending it again overwrites the Time In.

Expected: { "isSuccess": true, "message": "Time In of DO No DO-TEST-01 is saved (n lines). ..." } (the rest lists the Lorry Que times)

The delivery lorry goes out (after its Time In).

Fields (all required):
- do_no: the same DO No as the Time In.
- date_out: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, not earlier than the Time In.
- actual_weight: the weighed quantity, > 0, at most 3 decimals; written on every line with this DO No.
- actual_unit: the unit of actual_weight (e.g. KG, MT); must be a unit code of our Unit master.

Sending it again overwrites the Time Out and the weight. When this Time Out completes every line of the Despatch Ticket, the delivery is confirmed to CSL; once CSL has it, the DO Time In / Time Out of that ticket can no longer be changed.

Expected: { "isSuccess": true, "message": "Time Out of DO No DO-TEST-01 is saved (n lines). ..." } (the rest lists the Lorry Que times and whether the delivery was confirmed to CSL)
